		if #spamtxtssave > 0 then
			for i,v in pairs(spamtxtssave) do
				if spamtxtssave[i+1] == nil then
					index = i+1
					break
				end
			end
		else

		end
	end
	spamnum = index
	local num = spamnum
	if save then

		--spamtxtssave["max"] = spamnum
	end
	local previewcmd = string.split(txt," ")[1]

	if save then
